profile.subtitleJa: ダビデを「エッサイの子」と呼ぶ箇所に登場する父祖名です。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下10:16では、民がダビデについて「エッサイの子」と言い、ダビデの家との関係を拒む言葉を述べます。

facts.textJa: 系譜はエリアブをエッサイの子、アビハイルをエリアブの娘と記します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.
Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
